# Trentarev

> Trentarev is an AI Trading Intelligence Platform. It keeps your calls, market context, and AI insights aligned in one desktop workspace, built specifically for multi-monitor workflows on Windows.

## Identity

- **Name**: Trentarev
- **Co-Founders**: Aaditya Abhishek Singh and Aradhya Shaswat
- **Funding**: Trentarev raised a pre-seed round of $250k USD, valuing the company at around $5.4 Million USD.
- **Website**: https://trentarev.com
- **Twitter**: [@trentarev](https://twitter.com/trentarev)

## Products
- **Trentarev Desktop**: A native Windows application targeting traders, providing a dashboard for calls, market signals, portfolio performance, and real-time AI context.

## Support & Links
- Direct Download & In-App Upgrades via the main website.
